messages:
Gus: Quick heads-up 1 will open a tiny PR adding a compact "Streaming fallback" cheat-sheet to the Optimize toolkit. Goal: one-page fixes (curl, SDK toggles, config snippet) support can paste into tickets. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/9911
Leah: Love that. Can we also add a short Ruby and Rust snippet? We've had enterprise customers using those SDKs and no examples exist.
Gus: Yep planning minimal Ruby + Rust examples showing per-request prefetch override and disabling batching (explicit keys). Ruby snippet will be 3 lines, Rust 4 lines.
Rina: Also include a tiny deployment YAML example for Dedicated pools showing how to pin a quant profile per-deployment. Folks ask where to set that.
Tom: Please add an i18n note: the one-pager should avoid idiomatic language and keep code comments short so translators don't break snippets. Add a comment about running link-check after localization.
Gus: Draft YAML I'm adding:
```yaml
# dedicated-deployment.yaml
model: rwd-3
quant_profile: q8-balanced
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_ms: 8
```
Leah: Ruby snippet suggestion:
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(batching: {enabled: true, max_batch_ms: 8})
resp = client.generate(model: 'rwd-3', input: 'hi', prefetch: {enabled: false})
```
Rina: Rust (pseudo) snippet:
```rust
let client = Redwood::Client::new(Batching::enabled(8));
let resp = client.generate("rwd-3", "hi").prefetch(false).await;
```
Tom: Add a tiny troubleshooting FAQ: symptom -> quick check -> fix. e.g. "tokens stall" -> check stream headers + redwood.stream_p95_latency -> set batching.max_batch_ms=0 or prefetch.enabled=false per-route. Keep it 3 bullets.
Gus: Will include exact metric names and one-liners to pull them via console API (curl + jq). Example: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.redwood.ai/api/metrics?names=stream_p95_latency,kv_prefetch_miss_rate&range=5m" | jq .`
Leah: Tiny UX nit: add the sentence "Prefer per-route prefetch=false before changing quant profiles" since that's low-risk.
Rina: Also add a short note for Dedicated customers: if you pin q8-highmem and see effective_batch_size drop, increase pool size or switch to q8-balanced. Concrete numbers help: mention expected ~1.4x memory vs q4_0 (approx).
Tom: docs-bot: please run link-check + i18n-lint on merge.
docs-bot: @Gus scheduled link-check, snippet-lint, and i18n-lint when PR opens. Will flag internal-only URLs.
Gus: ETA pushing PR in ~30m. Ping for quick review when it's up. :rocket:
